title: Cleaner four-nurse changes screen
summary: Keeps the mobile navigation fixed and simplifies the exceptional four-nurse allocation screen so it reads clearly on iPhone.
changes: Keeps the bottom navigation fixed in one place on mobile with no scroll-driven translation.
Reflows the four-nurse theatre arrangement into a clean single-column mobile layout.
Turns the present-nurse list into compact readable chips and gives every theatre selector full width.
Reduces cramped side-by-side copy and improves spacing through the exceptional allocation flow.
